traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md define configuration presets, flat-config support, customizable story paths, rule options, project integration, and configuration validation requirements.
Concrete implementation exists in src/index.ts (flat-config presets and severity mappings) and in the rule modules' meta.schema definitions. Multiple Jest suites under tests/config and tests/rules are explicitly annotated as supporting this story and its requirements (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG, REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS, REQ-RULE-OPTIONS, REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION, REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION) and all pass in the latest test run. User-facing documentation in README.md, user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, user-docs/api-reference.md, and user-docs/migration-guide.md provides clear configuration examples, guidance for common project types, and troubleshooting guidance.
Although the story’s acceptance checklist leaves 'Error Handling' unchecked, the code and tests demonstrate graceful handling of invalid configuration options via JSON Schema validation (additionalProperties: false), pattern validation with fallback and explicit config error messages (valid-annotation-format), and branchTypes validation (require-branch-annotation). Given this evidence, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements are satisfied, so this story is assessed as PASSED.
